description: This file contains unit tests for the CompletionCustomHandler class, which is a custom callback handler for monitoring and logging events related to LLM API calls within the litellm framework. It specifically tests the behavior and assertions of the callback methods handling pre-call, post-call, success, and failure events, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: CompletionCustomHandler
classes.description: A custom callback handler class that extends CustomLogger, used for testing various logging and assertion behaviors during LLM API interactions.

methods.name: log_pre_api_call(self, model, messages, kwargs)
methods.description: Logs and asserts the expected data before an API call (synchronous).

methods.name: log_post_api_call(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs and asserts data after an API call, ensuring correctness of the response and context.

methods.name: async_log_stream_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that logs and asserts streaming event data.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs and verifies data related to a successful synchronous API response.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs and verifies data related to a failed synchronous API call.

methods.name: async_log_pre_api_call(self, model, messages, kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronous method for logging and asserting data before an API call.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous method for logging and asserting data after a successful API call.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous method for logging and asserting data after a failed API call.
